cancellation.1 Prediction: Cancellation risk for each booking when it is created.
cancellation.2 Metric and why: PR-AUC for ranking, with precision and recall at the operating threshold.
cancellation.3 Cut-off: Probability at or above 0.609, selected from the validation top quartile.
cancellation.4 Action: Send a confirmation reminder; staff review deposit eligibility before any request.
cancellation.5 Value: Contact 10,300 test bookings (25.4%); 79.8% are cancellations and they capture 52.3% of all cancellations. Random selection at the same volume captures about 25.4%; lift is 2.06x.
cancellation.6 Model: Logistic regression using booking-time features and training arrivals through 2016.
cancellation.8 Weak spots: Monitor recall by hotel, country and guest segment; do not use nationality to set the action.
cancellation.9 Re-check when: Review monthly. Retrain if PR-AUC falls 10% below the validation benchmark for two months.
cancellation.10 Human check: Staff confirm loyalty, company contract and local deposit rules.
cancellation.11 Finding: Long lead time and deposit type carry more risk information than nationality alone.

adr.1 Prediction: Expected ADR for each booking when it is created.
adr.2 Metric and why: MAE in euros because the error is directly understandable to revenue management.
adr.3 Cut-off: Quoted ADR more than EUR 20 below the model expectation.
adr.4 Action: Route the quote to revenue management before confirmation.
adr.5 Value: Flag 1,465 test bookings. Their average model-to-quote gap is EUR 40.16; the gross review opportunity is EUR 58,839, not guaranteed revenue.
adr.6 Model: Random forest using booking-time features and training arrivals through 2016.
adr.7 Score: Test MAE EUR 22.47 versus EUR 40.09 for the mean baseline, an improvement of 43.9%.
adr.8 Weak spots: Monitor MAE and bias by hotel and segment, especially high-price bookings.
adr.9 Re-check when: Review monthly. Retrain if MAE rises 20% above the validation benchmark.
adr.10 Human check: Confirm package inclusions, room constraints, promotions and contract rates.
adr.11 Finding: Season, hotel and requested stay pattern explain a material share of ADR variation.
